patch_description:
The previous best-performing program (score 0.98) utilized an expressive combination of permutation-equivariant input (RY, RX) and output (RZ, RX) rotation layers, achieving a test accuracy of 0.96. The current program replaced the naive 28-depth CZ sequence with an optimal 7-depth one-factorization schedule, but dropped the extra rotation layers, resulting in lower test accuracy (0.95) and score (0.78). 

Since all CZ gates commute, changing their application order does not alter the mathematical unitary of the ansatz block. By combining the optimal 7-depth CZ scheduling of the current program with the expressive two-axis input and output rotation layers of the best previous program, we will mathematically recreate the exact same training trajectory and high accuracy (0.96) of the 0.98-scoring program, but with a more hardware-efficient circuit depth.
